observations.why: The directive projects a recurring planned practice forward, while the cadence describes a general operational pattern rather than one specific event.
The contrast states a current condition and general principle: an unrehearsed rollback is treated as not actually possessed.
As a reported heading, this labels the projected recurring pattern rather than a completed or current event.
The phrase names a recurring planned practice in general terms, with monthly marking its forward-looking cadence.
The heading assigns responsibility for the planned practice, pointing to an organizational future rather than a completed act.
The named person is presented as the owner of the projected practice, making the reference concrete while retaining the surrounding future-planned stance.
